title: Lauren Boebert Loses Re-election Bid in Colorado House Race to Eileen Laubacher
summary: Ms. Boebert’s loss to Eileen Laubacher in a conservative House district represents a significant victory for Democrats.

Representative Lauren Boebert, a hard-line Republican, on Friday narrowly lost her bid for re-election in a conservative Colorado district,[according to The Associated Press](https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2026/11/03/us/elections/results-colorado-us-house-4.html) , an outcome that showed just how deeply Democrats had encroached into Republican territory this year.


Ms. Boebert, a fiery favorite of the MAGA movement, switched congressional districts a few years ago after her former district grew more competitive. But the change was not enough to keep her from being ousted by Eileen Laubacher, a Democrat.


Ms. Laubacher, a retired rear admiral in the Navy, was leading by more than 3,000 votes when The Associated Press called the race. Ms. Boebert said she called to congratulate Ms. Laubacher on Friday, four days after the Democrat declared victory, and hinted that she would not be retreating from the public eye.


“Public service was never meant to be a lifetime career, nor did I ever intend for it to be for myself,” Ms. Boebert said in[a video posted on X](https://x.com/laurenboebert/status/2121359607226364061?s=46) . ”Our founders expected representatives to serve and go back home.”


She added: “So I’m home, I am happy, I have peace, and this is not the last you’ll be hearing from me.”


Democrats flooded the airwaves in the district with more than $7 million worth of ads, outspending Republicans by more than 23 to 1, according to the media tracking firm AdImpact. Many of the ads fixed on Ms. Boebert’s polarizing nature and past scandals, with[one calling her “uniquely unfit.”](https://platform.adimpact.com/viewer/379b9bb0-3ef2-4d1c-a40a-00400c5db610)[Another ad](https://platform.adimpact.com/viewer/cead62b4-2c8d-499a-9f09-5b2906e1923f) contrasted Ms. Laubacher’s profile as a Navy veteran and mother of five with headlines about Ms. Boebert.
